mechanism: Both agents have CNS depressant properties and valerian may inhibit CYP3A4/CYP2C19, potentially increasing citalopram levels, while additive serotonergic activity carries theoretical risk of serotonin syndrome.
action: Monitor for excessive sedation, CNS depression, and serotonergic symptoms; counsel on avoiding concurrent use of other CNS depressants and consider baseline QTc assessment given citalopram's dose-dependent cardiac effects.
